cases.description: Tick 1, before the first head: it seals the genesis value and carries the first key-list version's fingerprint.
cases.name: first_tick

cases.description: Tick 2 seals a head and carries a timestamp token for tick 1. The token bytes are a test-only placeholder: only the token's form is read here.
cases.name: tick_with_a_token

cases.description: Tick 3 seals the same head as tick 2 under its own salt, carries the archiving key-list version's fingerprint and is the chain's final tick.
cases.name: final_tick

description: Population tick vectors. Test-only keys from fixed seeds; never a production or ceremony key. Each case gives a tick's text, the log key version to check it under and the result a reader must give.
